lang_code.description: ISO 639 language code to match (e.g., 'ka' for Georgian).

default_family.description: The generic font family to match against (e.g., 'serif', 'sans-serif').

target_font_family.description: The specific font family name to insert/prepend.

auto_hint_enabled.description: Whether to append the 'false' hinting setting for the font.
